p1.title: Penne with Cream Sauce
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
p1.instructions:
Boil the penne until al dente.
Melt butter, saute garlic.
Add cream and Parmesan, simmer.
Toss with pasta.

p2.title: Penne Arrabbiata
p2.instructions:
Cook penne.
Saute garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with pasta and parsley.

t1.title: Quick Tomato Soup
t1.instructions:
Saute onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and broth, simmer, then blend.

t6.title: Spanish Rice
t6.instructions:
Brown the rice in oil with onion.
Add tomatoes, water and salt.
Cover and cook until the rice is tender.
Fluff and serve.

g1.title: Garlic Onion Chicken
g1.instructions:
Season chicken.
Brown chicken.
Add onion and garlic, cover and cook 20 minutes.

g2.title: Roasted Garlic Onion Soup
g2.instructions:
Roast garlic.
Cook onions in butter.
Add broth and garlic, simmer, blend.
Serve.

b3.title: Eggless Banana Muffins
b3.instructions:
Mix wet ingredients.
Add dry.
Bake in muffin tin.

b4.title: Applesauce Spice Cake
b4.instructions:
Mix.
Pour into pan.
Bake 40 minutes.

c3.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta with Coconut Cream
c3.instructions:
Cook pasta.
Simmer sauce with coconut cream.
Toss.
